where: PR 81 at 6ddf00dfd37e9f92bb85742767b978d0ab119176; source-build job 137071715562 and preceding cold-bootstrap job 137067146761
what: The source-build command cannot select blaze-engine because the compiler is parked. Independently, a cold build of the native validation tools with the pinned release 0.20261105.4 ended with exit 76 LOOP_STALLED. Another job on the same preceding head built all 21 tools, and the final run restored that valid cache; a cache hit does not prove the cold-build stall fixed.
cost: Source-built compiler and end-to-end acceptance remain unavailable. The failed cold bootstrap consumed 541 seconds before its client reported the daemon exit.
cause: The compiler blocker is structural: upstream 8e87a017ff removed 662788 lines across 2081 files, including the daemon, query database and item/name-resolution layer. The retained engine still routes through that deleted daemon. blaze-surface supplies schema and Items/Source traits, but their only implementation is the MemSurface test fixture; signature, fields, variants, predicates, impl-index, body-facts and expansion APIs are explicitly unfinished, and the planned blaze-scope/blaze-expand crates do not exist. The bootstrap stall's native cause is not measured: the log shows main in loop turn for 131.3 seconds, four workers idle for 120.8 seconds, no wait-graph jobs and no unreaped children, but no native blocking frame.
prevention: Keep the source-built compiler and end-to-end gates strict. Complete the production item/source seam and the compiler/command bridge before reactivating their crates; selecting a released compiler or merely removing workspace exclusions cannot establish that proof. A future recurrence of the bootstrap stall needs the stalled native thread's stack before the daemon watchdog exits; the existing span-only log cannot identify the blocking instruction.
workaround: None claimed. Upstream's releases API still lists 0.20261105.4 as the newest published release, so there is no observed newer bootstrap release to substitute.
state: open; source boundaries and actual stall evidence audited, no compiler or runtime fix claimed
